plainLanguage: Kifungu hiki kinatoa kinga ya jinai kwa judicial officer kwa act au omission iliyofanywa bona fide wakati wa kutekeleza judicial function, isipokuwa Penal Code yenyewe imeweka expressly vinginevyo.
meaning: Kinga hii si kinga ya jumla kwa kila jambo analofanya judicial officer. Maandishi yana conditions mbili muhimu: conduct iwe bona fide na iwe katika exercise of judicial function. Kwa hiyo inquiry muhimu ni nature ya function iliyokuwa ikitekelezwa na good faith ya officer katika mazingira hayo.
keyPoints: Act au omission lazima iwe bona fide.
Lazima iwe katika exercise of judicial function.
Presence ya office/title peke yake haitoshi kama conduct haikuwa judicial function.

legalTerms.meaning: Afisa anayetekeleza judicial function; application ya term hutegemea legal office na function inayohusika.
Kwa nia njema/good faith katika utekelezaji wa function husika.
Kazi ya kimahakama au adjudicative function ambayo officer anatekeleza katika capacity yake ya judicial officer.
Kuwajibika kijinai kwa act au omission inayozungumziwa.

examples.title: Uamuzi wa kimahakama kwa nia njema
examples.scenario: Judicial officer anafanya procedural decision akiwa anatekeleza judicial function na kwa bona fide, lakini baadaye decision inapingwa.
examples.analysis: Section 16 inaelekeza kutenganisha alleged error katika bona fide judicial function na conduct inayoweza kuwa nje ya function au isiyo bona fide.

examples.title: Kitendo nje ya judicial function
examples.scenario: Officer anafanya kitendo ambacho hakitokani na exercise ya judicial function yake.
examples.analysis: Section 16 haiwezi kutumika kwa title ya officer pekee; statutory connection na judicial function lazima ionekane.

cases.name: Mzee Selemani v Republic
cases.relevance: Tanzanian criminal-law materials cite the case for the proposition that immunity does not protect conduct outside the officer's judicial function; the reported dispute involved wrongful detention.

history.summary: Judicial immunity in section 16 forms part of the Code's general rules of criminal responsibility. Its statutory purpose is narrow: bona fide exercise of judicial function, subject to express provisions of the Code.
notes: The provision should not be described as immunity for every act by a judicial officer.
For current statutory work, R.E. 2022 remains the app's source edition.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Analysis should focus on what function the officer was actually performing, rather than relying only on official title.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Bona fide is an express statutory boundary. Evidence suggesting conduct was not in good faith can therefore be central to whether section 16 applies.

debateQuestion: Kitendo kilikuwa sehemu ya judicial function gani, na facts zinaonyesha vipi kwamba kilifanywa bona fide?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
